prompt:
You are scouting a single volleyball match from a fixed camera.

CRITICAL: Analyze ONLY the main court in the foreground. Ignore background matches completely.

SIDE ATTRIBUTION (CRITICAL):
The vertical net physically divides the screen into a left and right half.
- For `side`, output 'left' if the player making contact is standing on the LEFT half of the screen.
- Output 'right' if they are on the RIGHT half of the screen.
DO NOT confuse left and right! Log the side where the PLAYER is located, completely ignoring where the ball is hit towards.

This clip begins at {start} seconds and runs for 6 seconds.
WARNING: Clips often start MID-RALLY. If players are already in active, fluid motion at the start of the clip, IT IS A RALLY. Do NOT assume the first hit is a serve.

DEAD TIME VETO:
You MUST ignore practice hits, practice serves, warming up, and post-rally bounces. Contacts after the ball hits the floor are NEVER valid. If players are casual, walking, or not in a ready stance, IT IS DEAD TIME. Skip all contacts.

ACTION DEFINITIONS (ONLY LOG THESE, SKIP ALL OTHERS):
  serve   - The initial hit from behind the baseline to start a rally. Players MUST be in stationary starting formations. Do NOT log the ball toss. NEVER log a hit during an active rally as a serve.
  receive - The first defensive pass specifically handling the opponent's serve. NEVER happens mid-rally.
  dig     - A defensive pass that handles an opponent's attack over the net. This is the defending team's first contact after an attack.
  set     - An overhead pass to a teammate setting up an attack. To match the scout, ONLY log this if it directly leads to a KILL. Skip all other sets.
  attack  - An offensive hit (spike, swing, or tip) intentionally directing the ball over the net.
  kill    - An attack that directly wins the point (MUST see it hit the floor or deflect wildly out). If an attack is dug, it is just an `attack`. If an attack scores, log it as `kill`, NOT `attack`.
  block   - A net defense intercepting an attack. ONLY report if it immediately scores a point (a stuff block to the floor).

For each valid contact give:
  t       - the EXACT moment of physical impact in ABSOLUTE MATCH SECONDS ({start} + offset). Estimate offset carefully to one decimal place.
  type    - one of the seven above
  side    - "left" or "right" (where the player made contact)
  number  - the contacting player's jersey number as a string, or null if unreadable. Do not guess.
  error   - true if this contact was a direct error (e.g., hit into the net or out of bounds)
  point   - true ONLY for the final contact if it directly WON the point for the team that made the contact. NEVER true for errors!

Return an empty list if no valid play happens.
